questions.stem_text: War became possible between nation states in the nineteenth century because:

options.A: the world was divided into several rival overseas empires
options.B: industrialization provided better transport, technology and administration
options.C: there was intense economic, political and military competition

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - all of the above

questions.stem_text: The media-themes model of media influence claims that:

options.A: audiences selectively interpret what they want to hear
options.B: content analysis is the best way to identify the themes covered by the media
options.C: audiences passively absorb whatever messages they are given
options.D: social interaction reinforces the ideas and images that audiences select

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - social interaction reinforces the ideas and images that audiences select

questions.stem_text: The 'class polarization' that Marx predicted referred to:

options.A: the division of each social class into the more or less privileged
options.B: a growing gap between rich and poor, resulting in class consciousness
options.C: the growth of intermediate strata in the middle classes
options.D: the tendency for the working class to live in very cold places

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - a growing gap between rich and poor, resulting in class consciousness
